load("decoder_eacZalm6/eac.bijlsma.186.s4b.Rda")
eset = data$expression_set
list.coph = list()
for (i in c(2:11)) {
  a = i-1
  if (!file.exists(paste0("/Users/markdings/Documents/PhD/Scripts/decoder_eacZalm6/K",i, "_res.mat"))) {
    list.coph[[a]] = 0
  } else {
  ds = read.mat(paste0("/Users/markdings/Documents/PhD/Scripts/decoder_eacZalm6/K",i, "_res.mat"))
  list.coph[[a]] = ds$coph
  }
}
plot(x = 3:11, y = list.coph[2:length(list.coph)], type = "o")

k=7
ds = read.mat(paste0("/Users/markdings/Documents/PhD/Scripts/decoder_eacZalm6//K",k, "_res.mat"))
rownames(ds$genesigs) = rownames(eset)
features <- c(sprintf("f%02d", seq(1,ncol(ds$genesigs))))
colnames(ds$genesigs) <- features; rm(features)
colnames(ds$samplesigs) = colnames(eset)
table = ds$samplesigs
factor = apply(ds$genesigs, 1, function(x) which.max(x))
ds$genesigs = cbind(factor,ds$genesigs); rm(factor)
list.topGenes = list()
for (f in 2:ncol(ds$genesigs)) {
  i = f-1
  print(i)
  temp = ds$genesigs[ds$genesigs[,1] == i,]
  distance = c(rep(0,nrow(temp)))
  temp = as.data.frame(cbind(distance, temp))
  
  featuresMatrix = temp[,3:dim(temp)[2]]
  
  for (g in 1:dim(featuresMatrix)[1]){
    maxWeight = max(featuresMatrix[g,])
    secMaxWeight = max(sort(featuresMatrix[g,],partial=dim(featuresMatrix)[2])[dim(featuresMatrix)[2]-1])
    dist = maxWeight - secMaxWeight
    temp$distance[g] = maxWeight - secMaxWeight
  }
  temp = temp[order(-temp$distance), , drop = FALSE]
  feature.top250 = rownames(temp)[1:250]
  list.topGenes[i] = as.data.frame(c(feature.top250))
}

library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
setwd("/Users/markdings/Documents/PhD/Scripts/decoder_eacZalm6")
pats.char = read.delim(file="Annotation_BiOESN174_Amber.txt")
load("eac.bijlsma.186.s4b.Rda")
pats.char$samplenameR2 = tolower(pats.char$samplenameR2)
result = merge(data$info, pats.char, by.x = "sample_id", by.y = "samplenameR2")
`%!in%` = Negate(`%in%`)
data$info[data$info$labid1R2 %!in% result$labid1R2.x,]

Merge weights with clinical characteristics

#sampleWeights = ds$samplesigs
sampleWeights = t(ds$samplesigs)
sampleWeights = as.data.frame(sampleWeights)
# To get a vector, use apply instead of lapply
sampleWeights=as.data.frame(prop.table(as.matrix(sampleWeights), margin = 1))
result = merge(result, sampleWeights, by.x = "sample_id", by.y=0)
result$toPlot = "NA"
result$toPlot[result$SampleLocation=="Esophagus"]="Primary"
result$toPlot[result$SampleLocation!="Esophagus"&result$SampleLocation!="Liver"]="Non-liver metastases"
result$toPlot[result$SampleLocation=="Liver"]="Liver"
result$toPlot=factor(result$toPlot, levels = c("Primary", "Non-liver metastases", "Liver"))
data_summary <- function(x) {
   m <- median(x)
   ymin <- min(x)
   ymax <- max(x)
   return(c(y=m,ymin=ymin,ymax=ymax))
}
ggplot(result, aes(x=toPlot, y=V7))+
  geom_dotplot(binaxis = "y",binwidth = 1/360, stackdir = "center", fill = "black",dotsize = 4)+
  stat_summary(fun.data=data_summary, color="red")+
  ylim(0,0.5)+
  theme_minimal()+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("F7: Liver")

ranked = result
ranked = ranked[order(ranked$V7,decreasing=T),]
ranked$V7Rank = seq(1:length(ranked$V7))
ggplot(ranked,aes(x=V7Rank, y=V7, color=toPlot))+
  geom_point()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette="Dark2")+
  theme_minimal()+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("F7: Liver")
